_note: PLACEHOLDER structure built on the six GCF investment criteria. Replace/extend with the 2024 GCF Water/Sanitation Project Design Guidelines framework (Chimdi/Silvia). Keep the keys stable if possible. guidance_id: Indonesian wording for template placeholders, awaiting Silvia's review.

sections.guidance: Accredited entity, country (Indonesia), sector, mitigation/adaptation, size, request.
sections.guidance_id: Entitas terakreditasi, negara (Indonesia), sektor, mitigasi/adaptasi, besaran proyek, permohonan pendanaan.

sections.guidance: Climate rationale based on ECAM baseline and climate risks; baseline scenario without the project.
sections.guidance_id: Alasan iklim berdasarkan garis dasar ECAM dan risiko iklim; skenario dasar tanpa proyek.

sections.guidance: Expected tCO2eq reduced per year and over lifetime for each ECAM-calculated option, stated separately (combined savings have not been assessed because actions may overlap, so do not add them up); beneficiaries.
sections.guidance_id: Perkiraan pengurangan tCO2eq per tahun dan selama umur proyek untuk setiap opsi hasil perhitungan ECAM, dinyatakan terpisah (penghematan gabungan belum dinilai karena kegiatan dapat tumpang tindih, jadi jangan dijumlahkan); penerima manfaat.

sections.guidance: Replication across Indonesian utilities (PDAM / PD PAL), knowledge, enabling environment.
sections.guidance_id: Replikasi di utilitas lain di Indonesia (PDAM / PD PAL), berbagi pengetahuan, lingkungan pendukung.

sections.guidance: Co-benefits: service quality, public health, NRW, cost savings, gender.
sections.guidance_id: Manfaat tambahan: mutu layanan, kesehatan masyarakat, air tak berekening (NRW), penghematan biaya, gender.

sections.guidance: Alignment with Indonesia NDC and national/local plans; stakeholder engagement.
sections.guidance_id: Keselarasan dengan NDC Indonesia serta rencana nasional/daerah; pelibatan pemangku kepentingan.

sections.guidance: Cost per tCO2eq (only with user-provided costs), co-financing, financial structure.
sections.guidance_id: Biaya per tCO2eq (hanya dengan biaya yang diberikan pengguna), pendanaan pendamping, struktur pembiayaan.

sections.guidance: Indicators, baselines (ECAM), targets, monitoring with repeated ECAM assessments.
sections.guidance_id: Indikator, garis dasar (ECAM), target, pemantauan dengan penilaian ECAM berulang.

sections.en: E. Risks, environmental and social safeguards
